responsibility: Implements MIPS common target option handling by setting the combined default target/cpu/endian flag baseline and normalizing several cache-flush and floating-point ABI switches into the target flag state stored in gcc_options. It clears mutually exclusive float mode bits for -mfp32, -mfp64, and -mfpxx, handles -mno-flush-func, and provides the common targetm_common initializer used by GCC’s shared option subsystem.
